description: This file contains the implementation of the socket-based communication system for handling execution approvals and remote command execution in a macOS application. It defines data structures, socket server logic, prompt user interface, and request handling mechanisms related to execution approval workflows.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle of the socket server that handles user prompts and command execution requests.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptPresenter
classes.description: Provides user interface prompts for execution approval using macOS NSAlert and accessory views.

classes.name: ExecHostExecutor
classes.description: Handles execution of commands in response to requests, including validation, user prompts, and running shell commands.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketServer
classes.description: A socket server implementation managing client connections for request handling, user prompts, and command execution.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Sends a request to the socket for an approval decision, with timeout handling.

methods.name: requestDecisionSync
methods.description: Sends a synchronous socket message requesting an approval decision.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the socket server to listen for incoming requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the socket server and cleans up resources.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Displays a user prompt for execution permission, returning the user's decision.

methods.name: buildAccessoryView
methods.description: Constructs a macOS NSView with command and context details to display in the prompt.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main handler for incoming client connections, dispatching decisions and execution requests.

methods.name: handleClient
methods.description: Processes individual socket client connections, decoding requests and sending responses.

methods.name: runAcceptLoop
methods.description: Main accept loop that continually listens for incoming socket connections.
